publishDialog.title: Publish this agent?
publishDialog.body: Publishing makes the current version the stable one your agent uses in Live.
publishDialog.successBody: Your agent is live. The published version will keep working while you iterate on new drafts.

empty.title: Describe the agent you need
empty.subtitle: One clear sentence is enough. Stack32 will build a first version, test it, and let you try it immediately.

mock.successResponse: Your agent is ready to test. I set up its goal, selected the right capabilities and ran a first test — everything passed. You can try it now in Live, or review its composition in Structure.
mock.warningResponse: Your agent is built, but the test surfaced a minor issue: one answer was less precise than expected. You can test it as is, or let me fix it automatically.
mock.errorResponse: I couldn't complete the build this time: the test failed while checking the agent's answers. I can fix this automatically — or you can rephrase your request with more detail.
mock.repairResponse: Fixed. I adjusted the agent's instructions and reran the test — it passes now. Your agent is ready to use.
